name: SMK Packaging
old_description: SMK Packaging is a vertically integrated low cost manufacturer of high quality custom-made flexible packaging with focus on the highly competitive fast-paced fresh produce market segment in the western USA.
about:
SMK Packaging was founded in 2011 by Steven Karlsrud in Reno, Nevada. The privately held company began as a vertically integrated operation focused on producing custom flexible packaging for the fast‑paced fresh produce market in the western United States.

The company controls the full production chain in‑house: blown film extrusion using three‑layer coextrusion and six‑component gravimetric dosing, prepress services including design, trapping, bar coding and plate making, printing on two eight‑color central impression flexographic presses capable of 50‑inch web width, and converting that produces wicketed bags, side‑weld bags, roll stock with vent holes, zippers and handle features. An on‑site laboratory performs OTR, tensile, dart, seal strength, haze, gloss, density and melt‑flow testing on resins, films and finished goods.

SMK primarily serves fresh‑produce packers and other food‑contact packaging customers across the western U.S., and is expanding into additional markets that require short lead times and responsive service. Its packaging is designed for vertical and horizontal form‑fill‑seal equipment used in automated and hand‑pack lines.

The business was built on a vision of responsiveness and vertical integration, aiming to eliminate bottlenecks by keeping every step under one roof. Management emphasizes flexibility — offering rush orders and custom film structures without long queue times — and maintains GMP and HACCP programs audited by third parties to ensure safety for direct food contact.
